body: **Foco:** Verbo-chave: give.
**Pronúncia:** Ajuste refinado de entonação.
**24 palavras novas** (literatura).
**Texto do dia:** texto acadêmico e resumo.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo usar give em seus sentidos avançados (give rise to, give way to, give voice to, give off, give in, given that) num texto acadêmico sobre recepção literária.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: How Novels Give Rise to Movements
paras: Few literary works **give rise to** social change by themselves, **yet** several have **given voice to** grievances that were **already felt**. Dickens, **for instance**, **gave readers** a face for poverty; his fiction **gave way to** a wave of reform debates. **Given that** novels reach private readers in private rooms, **their influence is slow to show**, but it can **give off** a lasting glow.

Critics should **give credit where it is due** without **giving in to** the myth of the lone genius. **Given time**, a book **gives a generation** its vocabulary. It **gives the lie to** the claim that literature **changes nothing**: it changes what can be **said**, and what can be **said** soon **gives shape to** what can be **done**.

items.q: The text says novels immediately change society.
items.why: their influence is slow to show.

items.q: Dickens gave readers a face for poverty.
items.why: gave readers a face for poverty.

items.q: The text says literature changes nothing.
items.why: gives the lie to the claim.

head: Expressão
Sentido
Exemplo
rows: give voice to / give way to
They **gave voice to** grievances; reform **gave way to** change.
It **gives off** a glow; don’t **give in to** the myth.
given that / give the lie to
**Given that** novels are private…; it **gives the lie to** the claim.

blocks.body: **Give** forma muitas combinações: com **substantivo abstrato** (*give rise, give shape, give credit*), com **partícula** (*give in, give way, give off*) e como **conjunção** (*given that*).
*Give in to* (ceder a) e *give up* (desistir) não são equivalentes. *Give up smoking* ✓, *give in smoking* ✗.

items.s: Few works ___ rise to social change. (give)
___ that novels reach private readers, influence is slow. (given)
It ___ the lie to the claim. (give)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: And why is the effect slow
items.pt: E por que o efeito é lento?

items.ans: How do novels give rise to change

body: **Give credit where it’s due.** — Dar crédito a quem merece.
**Give or take.** — Mais ou menos.
**Give the benefit of the doubt.** — Dar o benefício da dúvida.
**Give the game away.** — Entregar o jogo.
**Give someone a piece of one’s mind.** — Dizer umas verdades.
**Give ground.** — Ceder terreno.
**Give it a rest.** — Dar um tempo.
**Give and take.** — Concessões mútuas.
**Give rise to.** — Originar.
**Given the circumstances.** — Dadas as circunstâncias.
**How do novels give rise to change?** — Como romances originam mudança?
**And why is the effect slow?** — E por que o efeito é lento?
**They give voice to grievances that were already felt.** — Dão voz a queixas que já eram sentidas.

head: Phrasal verb
Significado
Exemplo
rows: The lamp gives off a warm glow. — A lâmpada emite um brilho quente.
Don’t give in to pressure. — Não ceda à pressão.
Doubt gave way to confidence. — A dúvida deu lugar à confiança.

blocks.title: Lecture hall
lines: How do novels give rise to change?
They give voice to grievances that were already felt.

And why is the effect slow?

Given that novels are read privately, influence takes time.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: Hardship can give rise to great art.
The novel gives voice to the unheard.
Given that time is short, I’ll be brief.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences about the influence of a book, film or song, using at least four give expressions.
blocks.model: The song gave voice to a generation’s doubts. It gave rise to many covers. Given that radio was dominant, it spread quickly. It gave off an air of hope. Critics gave it little credit at first. Time gave the lie to their caution.

Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
